resources.string: Photograph the fridge, freezer or pantry
Open the door, get a whole shelf in the picture and make sure it is light. Things that are hidden or in closed containers are not found.
The photo is made smaller and sent to %1$s without location or camera data. The cost is charged to your own account there. The photo is not kept in the app.
The camera is used to photograph your fridge. You can also pick a photo from the gallery.
The fridge photo is not available in demo mode: it needs a Tandoor and your own AI key. Nothing is sent from the demo.
Add an AI key in Settings
The fridge photo uses your own key for Claude, Gemini or OpenAI. Choose a service and paste the key under Settings → AI.
The AI can miss items, or believe something is there that is not. Everything it finds becomes a list of suggestions that you check before anything is saved in the pantry.

The fridge photo with your own AI key

Photograph the fridge and an AI service suggests what you have at home. It is experimental: the AI can miss items or see things that are not there, so you always check the list before anything is saved.
Demo mode never calls an AI service. The settings are kept for when the app is connected to your Tandoor.

Your photo, your key, your costs

The photo is sent only to %1$s, made smaller and without location, and is not kept in the app. Every photo costs a little on your own account at the service. The key never leaves this phone except in the call to the service, and it is not part of backups. The setting is for this phone, whichever Tandoor account is active.
